net_interface.description: Network interface to use for sniffing and MITM attacks (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0').

gateway_ip.description: Gateway IP address. Leave empty to auto-detect (recommended for dynamic environments).

http_proxy_port.description: Port for the HTTP proxy server.

https_proxy_port.description: Port for the HTTPS proxy server.

transparent_proxy.description: Enable transparent proxying (intercept all HTTP/HTTPS traffic without client configuration).

ssl_strip.description: Enable SSL stripping to downgrade HTTPS connections to HTTP (for credential harvesting).

addresses.description: IP addresses to return for each domain (same order as domains).

dns_spoof.description: DNS spoofing configuration: map specific domains to custom IP addresses.

arp_spoof.description: Enable ARP cache poisoning to position the host as the man-in-the-middle on the LAN.

icmp_redirects.description: Enable ICMP redirect spoofing for additional stealth on Linux (requires root).

credentials_capture_targets.description: List of protocols/services from which to capture credentials (e.g., 'http', 'ntlm').

session_hijacking.description: Enable HTTP session hijacking to steal active web sessions.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for captured data and events.

enabled.description: Whether the module should be enabled at startup.

startup_modules.description: List of modules to load and configure at startup, with enable/disable toggles.
